claims.statement: Retailers above 200 square metres must contract with every operator that approaches them, while smaller stores contract with at least one; retailer-operator and inter-operator financial settlement must occur no less often than monthly.
Retailers collecting returns must keep annual records of acquired and sold products, returned containers, and collected, returned, and unreturned deposits, and retain them for five years.
The Ministry page lists eight authorized system operators, including two authorized during 2026.
By 21 August 2026, the Ministry reported 3.2 billion returned containers, over 60,000 return points, 17,500 RVM-equipped points, and 88 percent of returns through RVMs.
Official guidance confirms that each operator designs detailed settlement rules contractually, so processes and documents can differ by operator and retailer participation model.
PolKa's IT system already receives return and voucher data in real time or manual reports weekly, exposes settlement documents, and verifies quantities and values used for retailer settlement.

COMP markets multi-operator support, settlement visibility, accounting/API integrations, and retailer packages priced 19.90-79.90 PLN net monthly; Insoft embeds COMP and Zwrotka workflows and settlement reports in established POS software.
Given the breadth and price of incumbent operational tooling, a new entrant would need to sell independent exception assurance or recovered-value evidence rather than another primary DRS ledger.
The incidence and cash value of unresolved variances after incumbent reconciliation are not established by public sources.
Public materials do not establish that retailers can export item-level operator, RVM, collection, voucher, and settlement data to an independent third party on commercially workable terms.
No sourced evidence establishes retailer willingness to buy a separate exception-audit subscription or the proposed chain-level pricing.

contrary_evidence: s06-comp-retail and s06-comp-operator: COMP already offers multi-operator handling, settlement reports, API/accounting integration, and low per-store pricing.
s06-polka-it: an operator-native system already provides transaction ingestion, settlement documents, and automated verification.
s06-insoft: a widely used POS product already includes DRS cashier, voucher, bag, and return-settlement workflows.
s06-volume: rapid deployment and transaction volume imply that core infrastructure and channel contracts are substantially in place.
